[db=live]Welcome to the Protection Warrior rotation guide for Midnight Season 2! This guide will teach you all about the optimal rotation for Protection Warrior across its various talent builds. It will cover both core ability cadence and cooldown usage in dungeons and raids for [b]Midnight Season 2[/b].

sections.heading: How to Play Protection
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Protection"][color=c1]Protection Warrior Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]
The rotation for Protection Warrior is fast paced and fun. It has many frequent procs that always keep you on your toes.
We primarily focus on building and spending as much rage as possible to cycle our cooldowns faster.


[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=inv_shield_05 size=medium type=round color=c1 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c1]React to Shield Slam Procs:[/color][/b] Shield slam should alwawys be used if it's ready, this will generate the most rage/threat/damage and keep your rotation flowing smoothly.
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_warrior_renewedvigor size=medium type=round color=c1 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c1]Avoid Rage Waste:[/color][/b] Trying to always keep your rage below the cap so you dont 'waste' any is very important. You can always dump more into [spell=190456]. 
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=warrior_talent_icon_avatar size=medium type=round color=c1 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c1]Utilize your cooldowns frequently.:[/color][/b] [spell=107574] is cast on cooldown, roughly every minute or so. We also have [spell=1160] shout which comes up very often. Don't be afraid to use [spell=871] to smooth damage intake where necessary.[/td]
	[/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=33045 icon=ability_warrior_defensivestance]Protection Warrior Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Rotation Priority

Prot warrior has several very short cooldowns it presses almost costantly. Maintaining the balance of rage and spending smoothly is what ensures comfortable gameplay.

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c1][icon name=ability_warrior_defensivestance type=round size=medium inline=true color=c1][/icon] Protection Warrior Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]
Protection Warrior has 3 main cooldowns they cycle offensively. [spell=107574]/[spell=1160] and [spell=385952]. These are all to be used on cooldown as best as possible.
[pad]

[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Avatar" icon=warrior_talent_icon_avatar]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c1] Avatar [/color][/h3]
Avatar gives you a multitude of perks and can be changed based on talents, but primary it increases all damage done and generally reduces the cooldown of Thunder Clap.
[/tab]

[tab name="Demo Shout" icon=ability_warrior_warcry]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c1] Demo Shout [/color][/h3]
This both reduces the damage mobs deal to you and damage you deal to them alongside generating some rage.
[/tab]

[tab name="Shield Charge" icon=ability_warrior_shieldcharge]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c1] Shield Charge [/color][/h3]
Shield Charges grants you [spell=2565] and stuns the target.
[/tab]

[/tabs]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c1][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c1][/icon] Protection Warrior Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]

[pad]


[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Always Be Casting" icon=spell_nature_thunderclap]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c1] Always Be Casting [/color][/h3]
	This is a classic staple for all specs in WoW, ABC. Always be casting. Your gcd usage is extremely important, if you are missing 10-20% of your total casts just because you aren't mashing fast enough then you are going to be losing a significant amount of damage and rage generation. This all plays into itself, less resources, less cdr, less damage when you need it.
	Your casts don't have to be perfect all the time, just make sure you are actually hitting something instead of mashing buttons that aren't ready yet.
[/tab]
[/tabs]
[pad]
